moving-people.scope: Real district routes, clocks and pointer events. Directory controls set up each approach; no simulation state is injected.

scope: Deterministic browser frames for six real rigs, plus live district walking clicks. Fixes gesture transitions only; target poses remain stylized. Does not establish full biomechanical realism, continuous collision, native parity or 60 fps.
browser_regression_sequence: Crowd checks preceded the culling corrections. The reaction fixture covers two-second and100ms gaps; it and live moving-person checks were rerun after explicit visibility suspension.
